Perfect! All tests pass. The bug was in the `weightFits` function at line 65 of route-planner.js:route-planner.js:65. The comparison operator was `<` (exclusive) when it should have been `<=` (inclusive) to match the documented behavior. 

The comment correctly stated that "Catalog maxima are inclusive," but the code was rejecting packages that matched the maximum weight exactly. This caused valid shipping options like SP-PRI (maxKg: 7) to be filtered out for 7 kg packages, resulting in `NO_RATE` errors or undefined codes.

The fix is minimal, preserves the public API and validation behavior, and allows the large catalog to work as intended across all regional lanes.
